reasons: The label checks are simple and clear, but no test run result was provided.
The check reads source text, so it does not confirm the label is visible on screen.

terms.meaning: The plain HTML a component produces, without running it in a browser.
A small label that shows which persona is speaking.

used_by: Run by the test runner as part of the unit tests.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup
sections.what: Imports the render helper, the test runner, the file reader, the persona chip component and the persona list.
sections.why: Provides the tools the label checks need.

sections.name: walk
sections.title: Source file walk
sections.what: Lists every component file under the source folder.
sections.why: Lets the label check cover every component, not just a fixed set.
sections.watch_out: Only files ending in the component extension are checked.

sections.name: AI labels
sections.title: AI label checks
sections.what: Checks every persona chip renders the AI analyst label, and every component that marks a persona voice also contains the AI analyst text.
sections.why: Likely reason: persona content must always show it is AI-generated.
sections.watch_out: The second check is a text search, so it does not prove the label is visible to users.

summary: Tests that every persona chip and every component that marks a persona voice shows the AI analyst label.
purpose: Makes sure persona content is always labelled as coming from an AI.
why: Likely reason: users must know AI wrote the analysis, so the label is checked in every place a persona appears.
how: Renders each persona chip to static HTML and checks it contains the label. Then scans all the component files that mark a persona voice and checks each contains the label text.
inputs: The persona list and the chip component, plus the component source files.
risks: The second check is a text search, so a label that is present in the code but hidden would still pass.
debug: If a chip fails, look at the chip component. If a file fails, check whether it marks a persona voice and contains the label.
